title: In a companion's one-on-one dialogue, 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' sits as an ordinary numbered option among conversation topics with no confirmation prompt. Selecting it by misreading the list (intending a neutral 'step back') instantly removed the companion from the party mid-conversation.
where: talking to Tamsin, at The Kings' Rest — Mouth (Hollowbrook)
